name: [Portal] Partner profile (medailonek) domain over st_crm.partner + partner_lng (BE)
description:
### Summary

This task builds the backend foundation for the partner profile, known internally as the medailonek, within Shoptet's new Partner Portal. The Partner Portal is a self-service application for agencies, freelancers, affiliate partners and addon developers, and the medailonek is the public card describing each partner on partneri.shoptet.cz and doplnky.shoptet.cz. Shoptet's CRM database becomes the master record for partners, and this task delivers the first PHP code that reads and writes those partner tables: a read model returning the partner with its Czech, Slovak and Hungarian texts, commands that save public fields and per-language draft text without touching already approved text, and the mapping between a logged-in portal user and its partner record. It deliberately excludes any user interface, any publication or approval logic and any public API; those are separate tasks that depend on this layer. It relies on the database structure created earlier and on the layering conventions established for the Partner Portal package, with delivery aimed at the April 2027 MVP for CZ, SK and HU.

### Why?

The partner profile is the **medailonek**: the public partner card shown today on partneri.shoptet.cz and next to addons on doplnky.shoptet.cz (name, logo, description, contacts, services). The Partner Portal needs a partner record it can read and write for it. `st_crm.partner` and `partner_lng` were created by , but no PHP code reads them yet. Today's only "partner profile" edit (API Partner → Settings) writes the _project_ record, not a partner record. The MVP scope puts the partner master record in CRM with the portal working over it; the medailonek edit screen, publication flow, public API and migration import all depend on this layer.

### What?

A backend domain layer for the partner profile in `cms/packages/PartnerPortal`: a read model for the partner and its per-language texts (CZ/SK/HU), a write path for public fields and per-language draft text, and the mapping between the logged-in portal user and its partner record. No screen, no publication logic, no public API in this task. Draft vs. approved text states follow the existing `partner_lng.status` design.

### Acceptance Criteria

Query returns the partner profile (public fields + texts for all languages with their status) by partner id and for the currently logged-in portal user

Command saves public fields (name, logo path, url, contact e-mail, phone, social links, country/region, hourly rate, currency, VAT-payer flag) with validation at the boundary

Command saves per-language text (description, benefit, priceText, metaDescription) as a draft row; an approved row is never overwritten by a draft save

Portal user → partner mapping is defined and tested, including "user has no partner record yet"

Writes go to the 

st_crm

 silo through the standard connection pattern; no per-project silo involved

Unit + integration tests cover the query, both commands and the mapping; new code passes PHPStan level 10

### Open questions

- Which side is authoritative when partner and project disagree (`emailForCommunication` vs. project e-mail, `cin` vs. project company id)? Wiki Q4 covers the migration side; the rule is decided here.
- `partner.slug` is globally unique while texts are per language. Is one slug per partner enough for CZ/SK/HU profile URLs?

### Technical notes

_Generated by Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-09-16_

- Tables: `database/schema/st_crm.sql` → `partner` (L2438), `partner_lng` (L2533, UNIQUE partnerId+language+status), `partner_category*`. Migrations `migrations/2026/devrel/crm/CZ3TDR1-572/`.
- Enums with zero call sites to build on: `cms/packages/PartnerPortal/Domain/Partner/Enum/{PartnerStatus,PartnerTextStatus,VerifiedLevel}.php`.
- Layering to follow: `cms/packages/Marketplaces` (Application / Domain / Infrastructure / Presentation), as set by .
- Write path _not_ to extend: `admin/controllers/ApiPartnerController.php:356` → `ProjectSaverHelper` (writes project, not partner).
- Legacy `st_api.partner` (status pending/approved/…) stays the source for API-partner approval; do not merge the two.
- `partner_lng` unique key allows one row per status, so a rejected draft and a new draft cannot coexist and there is no text history. Flag if that matters for the publication-flow task.
